component.name: OnionPress
component.summary: Your decentralized social blog, over Tor

description.p: OnionPress turns your computer into a web server running WordPress, accessible via the Tor network. Your site gets its own permanent .onion address backed up by the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.
Built on WordPress, Tor, and the Wayback Machine — for people who want to publish without depending on a platform.

ul.li: Native menubar / tray icon with site status at a glance
One-click setup wizard with optional social-media import (Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, blog feeds)
OnionHeaven fallback: when your site is offline, visitors see your archived copy

screenshot.caption: OnionPress tray menu showing your live .onion address

description.p: First-class Linux release — feature parity with the macOS app.

ul.li: Native AppIndicator tray with site status
One-click setup wizard with social-archive imports
Vanity .onion addresses generated automatically on first run
Single .deb that works on amd64 and arm64
